# `assets/material/TextureImport.js`

> **Source:** `engine/assets/material/TextureImport.js`

engine/assets/material/TextureImport.js — normalize textures + decode pixels (spec §7). A texture's colour space and usage are inferred from the material slots that bind it (sRGB for colour/emissive, linear for data/normal/ORM), so the same image used as colour vs data is handled correctly. Pixel decode is a separate, browser-only step (createImageBitmap) kept out of parsing. KTX2/ Basis stay compressed here and are routed by TextureManager to the existing native upload or registered decoder/transcoder hook path.

## Functions

### `normalizeTextures(model)`

Infer per-texture colour space + usage from the decoded material bindings, and normalize model.textures into self-describing EngineTexture records. Requires importMaterials() to have run first (so bindings exist).

**Returns:** normalized textures

### `async decodeTexture(tex)`

Decode a normalized texture's pixels to an ImageBitmap (browser only). Returns the bitmap (also cached on the texture) or null when undecodable (no bytes, external uri, or a compressed format with no transcoder).

### `async decodeAllTextures(model)`

Decode every decodable texture in a model. Returns the count decoded.
